title: A Survey on Large Language Model-Based Social Agents in Game-Theoretic Scenarios

bias_targets.methodology: Surveying literature that evaluates LLM agents in game-theoretic and economic scenarios (e.g., negotiations, auctions) to detect human-like decision-making biases, such as anchoring and numerosity biases, often by analyzing game outcomes or fitting utility function parameters to experimental results.

Reviewing studies that endow LLMs with specific socio-demographic profiles via prompt engineering to uncover behavioral disparities and strategic reasoning differences across different demographic characteristics.
